title: Design System: Xplora Points — Member account

display.purpose: Regular introductory heading; 42px at the mobile breakpoint.

headline.purpose: Compact greeting heading; 28px at the mobile breakpoint.

title.purpose: Points section headings; 27px at the mobile breakpoint.

body.purpose: Poppins explanatory text; smaller existing metadata is not a body default.

label.purpose: Visible labels for member and Points admin controls.

empty-title.purpose: Regular 22px heading on both desktop and mobile; h2 for page-level states and h3 within an already labelled section.

motion.name: compass-float
motion.value: 3.2–5.2s randomized segments; ease-in-out; endless; perspective 560px; large depth 28px
motion.purpose: The shared Points coin moves independently through random poses: X ±20deg, alternating Y ±18–38deg, Z ±12deg, lift 1–8%. Each segment starts at the prior endpoint; Web Animations API changes only transform and discards completed effects. The original face and eighteen statically shaded edge copies remain unchanged. Offscreen and hidden pages pause; reduced motion retains the static 3D pose.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: static compass pose; transition: none; hover transform: none
motion.purpose: PointMark respects the reduced-motion preference in its Web Animations lifecycle; the CSS media query disables button transitions and hover movement.

components.name: Points admin sections
components.description: Pressed-state section controls within the Points panel; Tasks is first and selected initially. These are buttons rather than ARIA tabs. Task creation defaults to Google Forms, exposes its edit-link field only for that type, and collapses its native disclosure after creation. Connection setup distinguishes unconnected, connected/paused, and enabled states, then collapses into a native recovery disclosure when enabled. The labelled HTTPS backend-origin field has associated help and inline errors; the private script download warns about its key. Enablement remains disabled until connected, and replacing a connection requires confirmation.
components.css: .ds-sections{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:24px 0;font-family:var(--ma-font-body, Poppins, sans-serif);}.ds-sections button{border:1px solid #cfc6dc;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#3e286b;padding:12px 20px;cursor:pointer;font:13px/1.65 var(--ma-font-body, Poppins, sans-serif);min-height:44px;}.ds-sections button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#603ef9;color:#fff;border-color:#603ef9;}.ds-sections button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #9075ff;outline-offset:4px;}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-sections button{flex:1 1 130px;padding:12px;white-space:nowrap;}}

components.name: Email verification code
components.description: Static six-digit code with system-font fallback; sample digits are illustrative.

narrative.overview:
Xplora Points extends the existing cream, ink, purple, Glacial, and Poppins identity into four focused member views: Tasks, Recompensas, Rachas, and Movimientos. Tasks pairs the actual balance with available tasks; the other views retain a quiet text balance. Plain, left-aligned empty states use concise copy and a relevant action when one exists. The original Xplora compass artwork remains unchanged, with CSS 3D depth and randomized infinite floating motion; inside Points it appears only beside the Tasks balance.

This document records the implemented Points boundary: member access and confirmation, account overview and shell, the shared open account panels and empty states used by profile, events, proposals, and jobs, access email, and the Points section inside the existing admin. This is a narrow refinement grounded in the existing code and reviewed local captures, without an approved visual comp. The root Startup Day document is not the visual authority for member composition; unrelated page content and administrative surfaces retain their existing direction.
keyCharacteristics: Regular Glacial headings and Poppins interface text.
Cream reading surfaces, dark balance/access areas, and purple actions.
Open lists and dividers around a small number of rounded panels.
Four query-linked views, a compact Tasks balance, and native disclosures for secondary detail.
Plain left-aligned empty states with concise copy, contextual actions, and no icons.
The original compass face, a shaded 3D edge, and a smooth infinite floating motion.
Explicit loading, eligibility, confirmation, delivery, and failure states.

rules.name: The State Label Rule
rules.body: Explain unavailable actions in their labels; color alone does not communicate eligibility.

dos: Do preserve regular Glacial headings, Poppins UI text, and the shared compass asset.
Do retain mobile stacking, the native account menu, query-linked Points views, and visible keyboard focus.
Do show eligibility, closure, confirmation, and delivery in readable text.
Do keep the balance and available tasks in Tasks, and older movements and multiplier details behind native disclosures in their own views.
Do distinguish Google Forms connection from task enablement, keep private setup behind native disclosures once active, and explain the matching account email beside the member task link.
Do use the shared compact empty state with meaningful copy and a next action where one exists.
Do keep the email usable with inline styles, presentation tables, and system fonts.
donts: Don't turn this account's composition into rules for the Startup Day recap or unrelated admin screens.
Don't invent stock, balances, rewards, or decorative status badges.
Don't add a main reward, forced points goal, progress bar, generic registration iframe, or repeated coins to the Points views.
Don't redraw the logo or add cardinal lines; preserve the original artwork, 3D depth, infinite float, and reduced-motion support.
Don't rely on motion, color, or remote fonts to explain an account state.
Don't show a failed proposal request as an empty history or wrap open account panels in extra cards.
